remarks: This modern residence is located in the center of downtown Westport. Ideally situated in the heart of it all, this location is conveniently situated near dining, shopping, and entertainment. This inviting one-bedroom home feature upscale amenities and spectacular views, making it the perfect alternative to New York City living, in a suburban setting. The Residences at 33 Elm offer a lifestyle of luxury. A lease can be arranged for one-year, two-years, or more. A video walk through is available upon request. Developed by David Adam Realty, designed by Architect Frederick W. Hoag.
